Added `specs/operator-lifecycle-consolidation.md`: the spec for issue #496 (consolidating the bare-metal/pool operator lifecycle). Three phases: ephemeral bake mngr namespaces (Part A), moving all operator/developer tooling into a new private `apps/minds_admin` app with a `minds-admin` console script (surface move), and server setup/prep convergence with env-aware order/await-delivery/setup commands (Part B).
